output.summary: A small evergreen tree or shrub native to tropical Southeast Asia, starfruit has crisp, juicy yellow fruit that forms a star when sliced. Its leaflets fold together at night and close when shaken, while fruit flavour ranges from very sour to mildly sweet.
output.edibilityNote: The fruit is edible; sweet forms are eaten raw, while sour forms are pickled or made into jelly, jam and juice.
